title: Putnami Database Requirements (manifest)
description: A project's declared logical database needs, keyed by logical datasource name. Secret-free: a requirement never carries a connection, so it can be projected into infra/requirements.json without leaking credentials. A deployer resolves each requirement into a binding (see putnami-database-binding.json).

databases.description: Logical datasources this project requires, keyed by datasource name.

datasourceName.description: Canonical logical datasource identifier: lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '/'; 1–64 chars.

engine.description: Database engine. Closed enum; postgres is the only v1 implementation and adding an engine requires a protocol version bump.

schemaName.description: Owning schema / search_path entry; an unquoted SQL identifier. Required for postgres.
